committer simonpunk <simonpunk2016@gmail.com> 1794589818 +0800

kernel & ksu_susfs: Add sus_path_uid_filter feature

Allow restricting sus_path visibility to a user-defined set of apps.
When the filter is set, only the listed apps can see the added sus paths;
all other processes with uid >= 10000 will not see them.

ksu_susfs (CLI)
- Add "set_sus_path_uid_filter <app_pkg_names_separated_by_comma>" command.
- New ksu_susfs/jni/features/sus_path_uid_filter.{c,h}.
- Register the command in features.h, and add its help + dispatch entries
  in main.c right after add_sus_path.

ksu_module_susfs
- Update ksu_module_susfs/boot-completed.sh for example of using
  "set_sus_path_uid_filter".
- Remove deprecated code example for kernel umount as it is not needed anymore since v2.2.0+.

kernel
- include/linux/susfs_def.h: add CMD_SUSFS_SET_SUS_PATH_UID_FILTER (0x55554),
  include <linux/bitops.h>, and add shared uid-filter macros
  (SUSFS_APP_STR_BUF_SIZE, SUSFS_UID_FILTER_MIN/MAX_UID, _UID_NUM,
  _BITMAP_LEN).
- include/linux/susfs.h: add struct st_susfs_sus_path_uid_filter and the
  susfs_set_sus_path_uid_filter()/susfs_parse_sus_path_app_strings()
  declarations, all under CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH. Make the priority
  uid filter reuse the shared macros and drop the now-unused
  getname_safe()/putname_safe() macros.
- fs/susfs.c: implement the filter as an RCU-published bitmap of allowed
  uids, protected by a mutex. App names are validated and resolved to uids
  from /data/system/packages.list with the KSU selinux domain temporarily
  switched on; the raw app string is stored so the bitmap can be rebuilt
  by a kthread when apps are installed/uninstalled.
- fs/susfs.c: add susfs_is_uid_allowed_for_sus_path() and rework
  susfs_is_inode_sus_path() to gate hiding on the caller uid (hide when
  uid >= 10000 and not in the allow-list) instead of the previous
  umounted-app + inode-owner check. The function no longer needs the
  LINUX_VERSION_CODE idmap variants, so its signature is unified to
  susfs_is_inode_sus_path(struct inode *inode) and marked hot. Also drop
  the now-unused susfs_get_data_path().
- fs/susfs.c: refactor the priority uid filter to use the shared uid-filter
  macros.

KernelSU patch
- kernel/supercall/dispatch.c: dispatch CMD_SUSFS_SET_SUS_PATH_UID_FILTER
  to susfs_set_sus_path_uid_filter(), gated on CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH.
- kernel/manager/pkg_observer.c: renew the sus path uid bitmap on package
  events with susfs_parse_sus_path_app_strings(), likewise gated on
  CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH.

50_add_susfs_in_gki-android14-6.1.patch
- Preprocessor cleanup: unify the include/guard conditions to
  CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS, add missing "#endif // ..." comments, mark the
  susfs_is_inode_sus_path() extern as __attribute__((hot)), and refresh
  the affected hunk headers.
